newsitem.title: USA: US Midwest spot propane slips in thin late trade.
newsitem.headline: US Midwest spot propane slips in thin late trade.

text.p: U.S. Midwest spot propane prices slipped in thin late trade Monday, players said, depressed in part by forecasts of warmer than normal weather in the region for the first half of January.
Spot propane in the Midwest trading hub of Conway, Kansas, was talked between 88.00 cents and 89.00 cents a gallon, two cents lower than the morning and five cents less than Friday
Mont Belvieu prices, meanwhile, were talked about 0.25 cent higher with little activity spotted ahead of the Christmas holiday.
Traders said they expected even less activity on Tuesday as many players begin an extended Christmas break.
